title: Scalar pullback squares and strict coefficient laws for Tate lines
statement: For the ordinary Tate-line pullback comparisons [def-pur-canonical-tate-ordinary-naturality] and completed integral scalar extension [lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension], retain the unit-normalized natural isomorphism comparing scalar extension after pullback with pullback after scalar extension. Its displayed equation is normalized by the actual ordinary scalar-extension unit and the actual ring-module pullback unit. Retain the integral reduction sheaf-line map and both original strict coefficient-law equations, including finite quotient reduction and finite coefficient-field extension.

source.place: Canonical root-arrow spatial, tensor and coefficient comparisons and their strict systems; existing naturality constructors relocated for compilation.

proof.text: The object formula for integralOrdinaryScalar gives the existing comparison with the change-of-rings extensionFunctor. Transport its standard scalar adjunction to the chosen ordinary scalar functor. Compare its composition with the actual module pullback adjunction through the same ordinary-square conjugation argument; its unit formula on sections gives the stated normalization and uniqueness. Retain the specified signed reduction line and strict coefficient equations. The generic conjugation helper is proved and private in the ordinary module, accessed through a proof import. No signature, public definition or theorem proof body is changed.

proof_origin.place: E9: existing constructors and proved helpers are relocated without statement or data changes after local canonical instance priorities and opacity reduced compilation cost but delivery preflight still took 62 seconds for the original consumer.

theorem ordinaryScalarSquare_existsUnique
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra (Padic l) L] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) L]
    (ι : E →ₐ[Padic l] L) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) :
    ∃! e : modulePull l E g ⋙ integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι X ≅
        integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι Y ⋙ modulePull l L g,
      ∀ (M : integralTowerModules l E Y) (V : Y.ProEt) (x : M.val.obj (op V)),
        (e.hom.app M).val.app (op ((proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V))
          (integralOrdinaryTensorSection l E L ι X ((modulePull l E g).obj M)
            (op ((proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V)) 1 (moduleSection l E g M V x)) =
        moduleSection l L g ((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι Y).obj M) V
          (integralOrdinaryTensorSection l E L ι Y M (op V) 1 x)
